name: cherry-electron-dev
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：cherry-electron-dev。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Develop, fix, and profile Cherry Studio in a tracked Electron instance. Use for everyday implementation, UI and interaction work, bug fixing, runtime debugging, DevTools inspection, lag or jank investigation, CPU and memory monitoring, leak checks, and startup-performance analysis; reuse a verified workspace instance across instructions and launch or replace one only when required.
